project.name: aikichun-progress
project.type: Angular 18 SPA, 100% standalone components, no NgModules

stack.styling: Vanilla CSS + CSS variables (Tailwind installed but NOT used)

src/app/core/.auth/auth.service.ts: Code-based auth (ADMIN123 / profiles.code), localStorage 'aikichun_code', role signal
src/app/core/.roadmap/roadmap.service.ts: Loads roadmap_steps from DB on init, visibility/lock, validateUpdate, getGradeProgress
src/app/core/.services/supabase.service.ts: Supabase client + profile CRUD + in-memory profileCache

src/app/features/roadmap/.roadmap.component.ts: ViewState machine GRADES/SECTIONS/LEVELS/STEPS, draft status, save
src/app/features/roadmap/.components/roadmap-step.component.ts: dumb: step card with 3 checkboxes + details

directoryMap.src/environments/environment.ts: Supabase URL + publishable key (committed, single file)

auth.session: localStorage key 'aikichun_code'; restored in AuthService constructor

roadmap_steps.note: DB column is 'spercentages' (typo, intentional) -> mapped to 'percentage' in RoadmapStep

dataModel.roadmapLoading: RoadmapService constructor loads roadmap_steps ordered by grade/section/level/step and replaces static ROADMAP_DATA if rows exist

lock.name: getVisibilityState
lock.rule: user can view up to 3 steps ahead of max progress index

saveValidation.name: validateUpdate
saveValidation.rateLimit: gates on updates_count >= 50, 5-day wait since last_update_date to reset cycle (code comment says '3 updates' - mismatch exists)
saveValidation.quantityRule: max 2 checkbox moves (forward progress) per save

businessRules.progress: getGradeProgress counts a grade's steps at or below the max pointer index (percentage rounded)

uiFlow.roadmap: GRADES -> SECTIONS -> LEVELS -> STEPS with back navigation; dumb selection components emit @Output events; logic in roadmap.component.ts

styling.approach: Vanilla CSS + CSS variables in src/styles.css
styling.tailwind: Installed and configured but NOT used (no @tailwind/@apply anywhere)

deployment.onPushMaster: npm ci && npm run build -> Firebase Hosting live channel

gotchas: environment.ts is committed with Supabase URL + publishable key; no environment.prod.ts (production: false always)
Supabase client uses persistSession: false to avoid NavigatorLock dev issues - keep it
SupabaseService keeps an in-memory profileCache (Map); clearCache() on logout
Admin edit popup only updates name/code, not status
Only test is app.component.spec.ts and it asserts on a removed <h1> - stale, expect ng test failures
Keep stepNumber values (e.g. SG1-01, SG1-A48) unchanged - they are primary keys for lock/progress logic
SupabaseService logs DB actions with styled console prefix [DB ...]
